scripts.dev: bun run build && node node_modules/.bin/cf dev --mode development
scripts.build:cloudflare: bun run build && node node_modules/.bin/cf build --mode development
scripts.deploy:staging: bun run check:staging-target && node node_modules/.bin/cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging
scripts.dry-run: bun run build && node node_modules/.bin/cf deploy --dry-run --mode development
